director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Chalo, main batati hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon. Ungli 6 wale nishaan par rakho, aur 10 tak ek-ek khaana kood kar jao. Har kood ek centimetre hai. Chabi 6 wale nishaan se 10 wale tak padi hai. Woh kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Chabi 6 wale nishaan se 10 wale tak padi hai. Woh kitne centimetre ki hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon.

director.text: 10 cm
Nahi, 10 cm theek nahi. 10 par chabi rukti hai, par shuru 6 par hoti hai; pehle wale khaane chabi mein nahi aate. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: 10 cm

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Seedhi par chadhna socho: doosri paidi se paanchvi paidi tak 3 baar chadhna padta hai, 5 baar nahi. Scale par bhi nishaanon ke beech ke khaane hi lambai hain. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan wahi toota scale hai, aur chabi ke sire se ginti shuru karke dikhayi hai: 6 se 7 tak pehla khaana. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: ek aur picture dikhao
Iski aur koi drawing mere paas nahi hai. Aakhri nishaan mein se shuru ka nishaan ghatao. Jitna bache, utne hi khaane cheez ke neeche hain. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

seams.form: Iski aur koi drawing mere paas nahi hai.
Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.

director.text: 4 cm lambi

Haan, bilkul theek. Chabi ke neeche chaar khaane aate hain, 6 se 10 tak: 10 − 6 = 4. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: ruko, main khud karti hoon
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: Sahi jawab, kyunki 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: Haan, sahi hai. Pehla khaana patte ke neeche nahi aata. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: 12 par

Bilkul sahi: 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: Nahi, kuch aur hai. Tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 4 se nahi. Isliye 12 mein se 5 ghatayenge. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Tehni ke ek sire se doosre sire tak ke khaane ek-ek karke gino. Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 7 cm

Haan, bilkul theek. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai, kyunki 12 − 5 = 7 khaane tehni ke neeche hain, aur har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 4 cm
Sahi jawab. Rubber ke neeche 5 se 6, 6 se 7, 7 se 8 aur 8 se 9: 4 khaane, toh 4 centimetre. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: laal lamba hai

Haan, sahi hai: neela 3 se chalkar 9 tak jaata hai, toh bas 6 centimetre; laal poore 7, isliye laal lamba. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: nau cm

Bilkul sahi, kyunki ginti grip ke shuru wale 6 se hoti hai, toh 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, yaani 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
chauka

Wah, chauka! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai. Ab seekhne par wapas aate hain. Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

seams.form: Ab seekhne par wapas aate hain.

j2.line: Wah, chauka! Toh tumhara favourite yahi hai.

director.text: phir se bolo
70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: thirty

Haan, bilkul theek. Bat ke upar 70 se 100 tak 30 centimetre bacha. Yeh lamba feeta hai, jis par sirf 10-10 centimetre ke nishaan hain. Jahan metre ka number likha hai, wahan poora metre hota hai; do numberon ke beech das chhote khaane. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Feete ka har chhota khaana 10 centimetre ka hai. Board par dekho: 10 aur 90 milkar poore 100 centimetre, yaani ek metre. Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?
director.card: Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: ek metre tees

Sahi jawab, kyunki 1 metre ke baad mez 3 chhote khaane aur jaati hai; 3 baar 10 yaani 30, kul 1 metre 30 centimetre. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Feete par 0 se is nishaan tak wala parda kitne metre aur kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain.

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is feete ke khaane scale jaise 1-1 centimetre ke nahi hain; yahan ek metre ke poore 100 centimetre bas das khaanon mein bante hain. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm
Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Pehle dekho, nishaan kitne poore metre ke baad aata hai. Phir uske aage ke chhote khaane gino, har ek 10 centimetre ka. Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

seams.form: Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.

director.text: ek sau chaalis centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek: parda 1 metre wale nishaan se 4 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 40 centimetre. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka matlab: ek poora metre, yaani 100 centimetre, aur 5 centimetre aur. Toh 105 centimetre. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

director.text: 28 cm

28 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. 4 metre 2 centimetre mein chaar poore metre hain, aur har metre 100 centimetre ka hai. Unke baad bas 2 centimetre aur, toh kul 402 centimetre. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?
director.card: Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?

director.text: pipe hai na

Sahi jawab, kyunki pipe 1 metre 5 centimetre, yaani 105 centimetre hai, jo danda ke 90 aur dhaage ke 70 se zyada hai. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi ribbon centimetre mein kitni hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: 208 cm hai na

Haan, sahi hai. 2 metre = 200 centimetre, aur 200 + 8 = 208 centimetre. Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain. Ek rassi 3 metre lambi hai. Usmein se 40 centimetre kaat diya. Kitni rassi bachi, metre aur centimetre mein? 40 centimetre ghatane se pehle 3 metre ka kya karoge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, aaram se hal karte hain.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
